dedupe_keys.name: top down food chain energy and greenhouse gas emissions model for european economic area countries v7 0 2019

description: This workbook estimates the greenhouse gas emissions, including those from electricity use, of the whole food chain in European countries, from farms and fishing boats through cold storage and the other stages to human consumption. The producers are Alan Foster and Antonio Rossetti, who built the top-down method to show how country differences in energy sources and refrigeration affect food chain emissions. Coverage is ten countries chosen to represent the EU27 plus Norway, for 2019. The model separates direct emissions from purchased electricity, reports leaks of fluorinated refrigerants separately, and uses each country's grid carbon intensity, which ranged from 0.018 to 0.776 kilograms per kilowatt hour. Food accounted for 10 to 24 percent of national emissions, farming and fishing for 58 percent of the chain, and storage for only 0.4 percent. The static workbook, version 7.0, is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: a top-down allocation from national statistics, one year, and the method details are in the associated paper. Simulation uses: estimating electricity demand and refrigerant risks of food cold chains and processing in energy and climate models. Related records: EDGAR-FOOD (data-edgar-food) and the FAOSTAT agri-food emissions shares (data-faostat-agrifood-emissions-shares) give global food system emissions.

name: Top-down food chain energy and greenhouse gas emissions model for European Economic Area countries (v7.0, 2019)
schema_summary: Static workbook of the top-down model for 2019 (excluding the UK): food system energy use and Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions by part of the food chain from agriculture and fishing to consumption (including storage), with HFC refrigerant emissions separated and country grid emission intensities, for ten countries representing the EU27 plus Norway

sources.note: Creators Foster, Rossetti; CC BY 4.0; published 2025-11-11; P70_TOP_DOWN_FS_and_EMISSIONS_2019_noUK_STATIC.xlsx; model for 'A comprehensive top-down method to determine food chain emissions in European Economic Area countries'; ten countries representing the EU27 plus Norway; Scope 1 and 2 emissions with HFC fugitive emissions shown separately; food share of national emissions 10-24%; Scope 1 is 84% of food emissions, 5% of these from HFCs; grid intensity 0.018 to 0.776 kg/kWh; agriculture and fishing 58% of food chain emissions; storage 0.4%
